info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v2-spec
info.description: The Delivery Driver Management API enables users to obtain a comprehensive list of delivery drivers associated with food delivery orders. This endpoint is crucial for businesses looking to streamline their logistics and optimize resource allocation. Developers can leverage this API to retrieve driver information, which can enhance order tracking and delivery efficiency. Typical consumers include food delivery platforms, logistics coordinators, and businesses involved in food transportation.

get.summary: Retrieve deliveries assigned to a driver
get.description: This endpoint allows retrieval of all deliveries currently assigned to a specific driver, providing relevant details such as delivery time and status. It helps in managing and tracking the delivery workflow efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving driver delivery details. Ensure to provide the necessary driver identification and any other relevant data as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and driver delivery information returned.
